title: cotoneaster racemiflorus var. soongoricus
intro: Cotoneaster racemiflorus var. soongoricus, commonly known as Soongor cotoneaster, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, alleviating pain, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Cotoneaster racemiflorus var. soongoricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
